reviews.text: He was a kind young man, very thorough, and I'm very satisfied with the result.

This is the grooming salon we always use.

The staff are all so kind to my dog, so he's always really happy to go to the salon.

They always do a thorough job and make him look so cute, so I can leave him in their care with complete peace of mind. This is a salon we want to continue going to for a long time.

My elderly dog ​​is shy around strangers, but they always treat him kindly, so I feel completely at ease leaving him in their care.

They also give me a message card after grooming that explains his skin condition, which makes me trust them completely!

I first used their services when my dog ​​was a puppy, and I've been going back for grooming, shampooing, and nail trimming so many times I've lost count!
When my dog ​​was a puppy, he was very restless and easily angered, so I was very worried when I left him there. But now he looks forward to going to Links, and even during our regular walks, he often tries to head to the salon on his own. I can tell from his behavior that the staff are very kind and loving towards him (¯ᵕ¯)
Thank you so much as always!
I look forward to continuing to use your services!

I've been a loyal Linx customer ever since my first grooming session there. I've been going there since before they moved. I'm so grateful for the careful and adorable grooming they always do. I trust them because they always tell me about how my dog ​​is doing during grooming and even any slight skin abnormalities that I might not have noticed myself. My dog ​​loves the kind owner, and is always so happy to show me her belly when we arrive at the shop. It makes me smile to see how well she's taken care of. The owner is usually the only one there, but all the other staff members are also very kind. It's my favorite shop.
I bring my two dogs in for grooming and shampooing, and they are always very thorough and the prices are reasonable. Both of my dogs are happy to go when they hear it's time for a shampoo.

They always cut my dog's hair carefully. They give him a hairstyle that suits him because he gets hot easily. He looks forward to going to the groomer and gets very excited when I tell him we're going.

The salon is clean, and everything, including the shower, is visible. I was struggling to find a good grooming salon, but my dog-loving friends recommended this one, and I knew how good it was from my first visit. Since then, I've been going there every month. The owner-groomer is not only highly skilled but also kind and wonderful, so I leave my dog ​​there with complete peace of mind.

The shop is clean, bright, and lovely. The shop owner is always so kind and friendly, which helps my dog, who is initially a little nervous, feel at ease. They always do a thorough job, and I'm always very satisfied! When I pick up my dog, they send me a letter with pictures and photos of my dog, which I always cherish.

I look forward to continuing our relationship for many years to come! 😊

All the staff are so kind, and my dog ​​has become completely attached to them. When I bring her there, she gets so excited to go inside! ☺️ She comes back with soft, fluffy fur, so I'm always very happy.

I can always leave my dog ​​in their care with peace of mind because they always do such a beautiful job 🐶🌟 It's the best feeling when their fur becomes fluffy and silky 🤭 I'm also happy that they send me cute photos every time 👏 …
They send me photos of my dog ​​looking very happy in the bath. I can entrust my dog's grooming to them with peace of mind because they cut his fur exactly as I want.

They provide very courteous service, and I feel completely at ease leaving my dog ​​in their care.

Every time my dog ​​goes for grooming, he wags his tail and heads to the shop, looking very happy!

This is the grooming salon we always go to ✨️ They do a thorough and adorable job, and I'm always very satisfied! My dog ​​is happy to go into the shop, so I feel at ease leaving her there knowing that she's well cared for 😌 I highly recommend it 🐶 …

I've been bringing my dog ​​here for many years, and I always feel at ease leaving him in their care because they're always so polite and kind. Not only are their skills excellent, but they also keep me updated on his health. My dog ​​has been having skin problems, but they've given me lots of advice, and it's improving. I look forward to continuing to use their services.
The grooming is always stylish and cute. I love the meticulous attention to detail in the trimming ♥

I use this grooming salon because it's in my neighborhood, and I've found the staff to be incredibly kind. They treat the dogs with the same respect and care. They cut my dog ​​exactly as I request, and I feel completely at ease leaving my beloved pet in their care.

I'll definitely continue using their services!

The shop owner is a kind and pleasant man. He grooms carefully, so you can leave your pet in his care with peace of mind!

I also appreciate that he sends pictures via LINE.

It's a calm and charming shop located a little off the main street.

My dog ​​isn't very good at grooming, but they're very considerate and we've been bringing him here.
He loves the staff and seems to enjoy coming here ☺︎
We'd like to continue entrusting him to their care!
They always cut our dog's fur so carefully and cutely in a round shape, and our dog loves going to Lynx.

We always rely on your services for our dogs and cats.

The shampooing and cutting are done very carefully, and we are extremely satisfied with the complete lack of shedding after we return home.

Thank you as always!

I had been searching for a good grooming salon for a long time, but I've finally found one where I can leave my dog ​​with peace of mind✨ They are very careful, and their cuts are excellent; my dog ​​looks adorable every time✨ I'm truly grateful that they've continued to treat my dog ​​so well even after he had paralysis following his hernia surgery🙇‍♂️ My dog ​​is also very happy when he goes for grooming🐶✨
Thank you for your continued support✨

The service was polite and kind, and the atmosphere was very homey, so I felt completely at ease leaving my dog ​​in their care 🐶
I would love to continue using their services for many years to come! …
I always feel at ease entrusting my dog's care to your brother because he is kind, gentle, and sincere.

I've been going to this salon since it opened next to the Gyomu Supermarket.
It's been run by a young, single-handed owner.
He's incredibly friendly and I can tell he loves dogs, and the dogs are so attached to him, I feel at ease leaving my pet there.
His cutting skills are excellent, and he even offers design cuts.
Every time I pick up my dog, he writes a postcard with a report of how he's doing and any areas of concern he notices.
He has an in-room photo booth, and he sends me cute photos of the cut and the process.
He always gives me a thorough cut, so I often get told "my cut looks so cute" while I'm out on a walk or out and about. 😃

They also cater to large dogs, which is very helpful.
Their prices are also the most reasonable in the area!
Cutting and shampooing dogs is such a pain, so I feel like this salon could be even better! I'm so satisfied with this salon, and it's my favorite.

I visited for the first time today.

The shop was very clean and the service was excellent,
and I felt completely at ease leaving my dog ​​there for grooming.

Thank you for taking such cute photos!

I highly recommend Links to any pet owners who are struggling to choose a grooming shop! ☺✨

I'm always grateful for the services of Lynx, a highly-regarded grooming salon among dog lovers.

Their prices are about half of other salons, yet their skills are exceptional, and I'm always satisfied with the results.

You can really feel the groomers' genuine love for dogs.

I feel completely at ease leaving my dog ​​with them.

They also take adorable photos of my dog, which is very heartwarming.

They even gave me some Lynx merchandise as a complimentary gift.

I highly recommend this grooming salon to all dog lovers!

It's a salon I would definitely recommend visiting at least once!

My 8-year-old miniature dachshund has been under your care for a long time.
They are a trustworthy store with polite and kind service. Thank you as always.
I look forward to your continued support.

The shop is very clean and has a great atmosphere. My dog ​​is 15 years old and has trouble with his hind legs, making grooming difficult, but they did a beautiful job.

At other pet salons, he barks at men, but I'm surprised he's so friendly with the staff at Lynx.

The staff are kind and have great personalities, so I feel completely at ease getting my dog ​​groomed there. ☺️

I'll definitely be back! Thank you! ☺️
